question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: AUSPICIOUS
solution:
The correct answer is: **Beneficial**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"auspicious"** refers to something that is favorable, promising success, or indicative of good fortune. (शुभ)
 
 
• **Example:** The wedding was held on an auspicious day according to the Hindu calendar.
 
 
• **"Beneficial"** means something that is helpful or advantageous, promoting a positive outcome. (लाभकारी)
 
 
• **Example:** Regular exercise is beneficial for maintaining good health.
